additional_info.subject: FW: ASD-16191 It seems to be that Automatically stop session when the available balance falls below this amount is not functioning properly
additional_info.body:
Dear Sadek,
Good morning !
This is to inform you that we have configured our tariff settings such that when a customer's balance reaches the minimum amount of 2 AED, the charger should automatically stop. However, we have observed that the charger is not stopping automatically after reaching the 2 AED threshold. Instead, it continues to operate, leading to a negative balance and impacting our revenue.
As this issue is affecting our operations, we kindly request you to investigate the root cause. Please review and let us know your findings at your earliest convenience.
For your reference, please find below email.
Charger serial no: MP/R8 170002526
Your prompt assistance in resolving this matter would be greatly appreciated.
Regards,
Nadeem

additional_info.subject: Analysis
additional_info.body:
Notes for NOC Stand-up Discussion:
Issue:
The charger is not stopping the session after receiving multiple stop requests.
Session Details:
Session started: 2025-03-28, 10:01:04
Session stopped: 2025-03-28, 11:03:10
EV SOC:
Initial SOC: 17%
Final SOC: 100% when the session was stopped
Multiple Session Stop Requests:
2025-03-28, 10:13:37
2025-03-28, 10:15:37
2025-03-28, 10:17:37
Final stop on the same transaction ID: 2025-03-28, 11:03:10
Error Code:
67 ("ERR_EV_DROPPED, vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B")
This indicates the EV stopped charging in an emergency shutdown manner. A possible cause could be the EV stopping the session early due to a V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid) communication issue.
Next Steps:
Need to discuss the issue with RKS during the NOC stand-up for further investigation and resolution.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416622-DC/Si-D/AE- [MP / R8 170002526] Automatic Session Stop Not Working When Balance Falls Below Threshold Amount of 2 AED CRM:02023000570
additional_info.body:
Dear Nadeem Manaf,
We have reviewed the logs and observed that the charger did not stop the session after the stop transaction was accepted. Upon further investigation, we found that the OCPP backend (wss://cpc.uaev.ae:443/uaev) has not been successfully integrated, indicating a potential issue with the backend integration. Our regional service team will reach out to you for further details and assistance.
In addition, I will be discussing this behavior with our expert colleagues and will provide you with an update as soon as I have more information.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation
With best regards,
